title: International Higher Diploma In Logistics And Supply Chain
description: This program develops self-reflective professionals equipped to meet the evolving demands of the logistics and supply chain sector.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: The purpose of this International Baccalaureate Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain (Level 6) is to professionally and individually develop self-reflective students capable of meeting the demands of the logistics and supply chain sector and thriving in a constantly changing global environment. This course enhances your ability to understand supply chain challenges, analyze logistics management problems, and develop practical solutions. It introduces the essential concepts of logistics and supply chain management, equipping you with the critical skills and knowledge to excel in higher education or the professional world, standing out as a competent logistics and supply chain specialist. This International Baccalaureate Diploma in Logistic and Supply Chain(Level 6) serves as a basis for your further business education and attracting employment opportunities. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 6 Baccalaureate Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain will equip students with the credentials to pursue careers in logistics coordination, supply chain management, procurement, warehouse operations, or supply chain consultancy.

entry: For entry into Level 6 International Baccalaureate Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: After completing this Level 6 endorsed qualification, students can progress to a variety of university courses that align with their academic and career goals or potential university progression pathways.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
